repos.description: WiFi DensePose turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time human pose estimation, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.

aiSummary.summary: WiFi DensePose通过分析WiFi信道状态信息（CSI），实现无视频的人体姿态估计、呼吸心跳监测及穿墙存在检测，采用物理模型与机器学习结合的实时信号处理方案。
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于智能家居、健康监护及无接触式人体状态感知的物联网场景

repos.description: IDE for the AI Agents Era - Run an army of Claude Code, Codex, etc. on your machine
